newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle sales active at $108-$110 - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle sales active at $108-$110 - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle trading turned active late Tuesday morning with about 20,000 head traded from $108.00 to $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, market sources said.
Sources called the prices $2.00 to $4.00 per cwt lower from the large volume that traded last week at $112.00. A few cattle sold Monday at $109.00.
Sources said packers appear to be shortbought and animals sold Tuesday should be shipped by the end of this week.
On a live basis, cattle were bid $67.00 but there was no reported trading.
